statements.status_notes: The crash is in eu-strip -f with --reloc-debug-sections on a crafted file whose symbol table section is not a real symbol table (https://sourceware.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=32673). It is fixed upstream in elfutils 0.193 by commit fbf1df9ca286de3323ae541973b08449f8d03aba. The published packages are elfutils 0.192 without that change, and the bug's reproducer still crashes eu-strip from the current amd64 and arm64 packages. Upstream does not consider it a security vulnerability and said so on the bug, citing its security policy (https://sourceware.org/cgit/elfutils/tree/SECURITY), which treats crashes of the elfutils tools on crafted input as ordinary bugs and advises users of the tools and libraries not to run elfutils analysis on untrustworthy input. Debian rates it unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-1377). Because the crash still reproduces in the published packages, this stays under investigation. Pending: an elfutils build that carries the upstream fix, or a maintainer decision that the input reaching this code is trusted for every program that uses these packages, including other programs that link libelf and libdw.
